reading: The sketch is a monitoring/observability dashboard: a header bar, a row of 4 stat cards, a requests-by-status chart block, a log/event table, and a right-hand alerts panel. All content and exact styling (colors, sizes, positions, text) come from the typed notes, which take precedence over the rough ink outlines; the whole page uses a near-black background with light grey body text per the run-scope note.
